title: Shared reference register including RSL systems
scope: Add RSL systems (online_refunds, audit_system, psrm, etax, idms, asycuda) to the canonical service links and expose one case reference card (RSL claim, TIN, RSL audit case, Vati case, Jube case, OpenAleph collection) to every Vati surface

acceptance.text: Vati Service Link accepts the RSL services with the same tenant and conflict rules
A case reference endpoint returns every mapped reference the caller may see
Record relevant tests and evidence, update task status and open a PR

notes.text: Added 2026-11-07 from ADR-043 (Vati downstream of RSL selection; portal answers evidence requests).
